description:
Listen to Amal, Out Everywhere:
https://levantine.ampl.ink/Amal

-

"Rah Telhaqni" - The first single from the upcoming album "Xetopia", featuring the up and rising talented vocalist "Desana".

This song is super special to me, it celebrates all my inspirations and introduces my new sound. 
The song revolves around the idea of companionship, when hell breaks loose and the whole world as we know it comes to an end "Will you catch me when I fall?".

Lyrics:

When the sun sets its place.
And the skies are covered with darkness
The day I fall to the ground
Will you catch me? 

When the birds immigrate.
From the doomed land
The day I fall to the ground
Will you catch me? 

Will you catch me? 
Will you catch me? 

When the birds immigrate.
From the doomed land
The day I fall to the ground
Will you catch me? 

When evil spreads
And when hunger eats me alive
When thunder screams.
And my sheltered home collapses.

When the blood in my veins is dry
And my heartbeat stops in a matter of seconds
The day I fall to the ground
Will you catch me?
Will you catch me?

Will you catch me?
Will you catch me?

When the blood in my veins is dry
And my heartbeat stops in a matter of seconds
The day I fall to the ground
Will you catch me?

Remember when we were young?
Our eyes sparkled.
The day I fell to the ground
You came to catch me

Till that time however the circumstances
And whatever happens happens
Till that time however the circumstances
And whatever happens happens
Till that time however the circumstances
And whatever happens happens
The day I fall to the ground
You'll come and catch me.


"رح تلحقني"، أول أغنية من ألبومي القادم "زيتوبيا" بالاشتراك مع المغنية الصاعدة "ديسانا".

الأغنية هاي جدا مميزة بالنسبة الي، بتمثل مقدمة لصوتي الجديد، اول اغنية الكترونية بكتب فيها كلمات عربية و بتعاون فيها مع مغنية عربية، و بتظهر كل الاساليب اللي بتأثر فيها بطابع موحد

فكرة الاغنية تتمحور حول فكرة الرفقة، لما كل شيء ينهار و العالم ينتهي، "رح تلحقني؟"
